title: Najdorf: 45 boards blindfolded
post: He played 45 games blindfolded so his family could find him 💔♟️ #chess #history #story #najdorf

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This man played forty-five games of chess at once. Blindfolded. And the record wasn't the point.
phrases.say: [serious] This man played forty-five games of chess at once... Blindfolded. And the record... wasn't the point.

phrases.text: Warsaw. Najdorf is the rising star of Polish chess.
phrases.say: Warsaw. Nigh-dorf is the rising star of Polish chess.

phrases.text: In his most famous game, he gives up both bishops, both knights, and mates with a pawn.
phrases.say: In his most famous game, he gives up both bishops... both knights... [excited] and mates with a pawn!

phrases.text: In 1939, he sails to Buenos Aires for the Chess Olympiad. At home, his wife Genia and their daughter Lusia wait for him.
phrases.say: In nineteen thirty-nine, he sails to Buenos Aires for the Chess Olympiad. At home, his wife Genya and their daughter Lusha wait for him.

phrases.text: Najdorf stays in Argentina. No letters. No news.
phrases.say: Nigh-dorf stays in Argentina. No letters... No news.

phrases.text: So he tries the one thing he has. Chess.
phrases.say: So he tries the one thing he has... Chess.

phrases.text: 1943. Forty boards at once, blindfolded. A world record.
phrases.say: Nineteen forty-three. Forty boards at once, blindfolded. A world record.

phrases.text: Maybe the papers will reach Europe. Maybe his family will see his name and know he's alive. Nothing.
phrases.say: Maybe the papers will reach Europe. Maybe his family will see his name... and know he's alive. [sighs] Nothing.

phrases.text: 1947, São Paulo. Forty-five boards. Twenty-three hours. He wins thirty-nine. Newspapers around the world print his name.
phrases.say: Nineteen forty-seven. São Paulo. Forty-five boards. Twenty-three hours. He wins thirty-nine. Newspapers around the world print his name.

phrases.text: His wife, his daughter, his parents, his four siblings. All murdered in the Holocaust.
phrases.say: [sad] His wife. His daughter. His parents. His four siblings. All murdered in the Holocaust.

phrases.text: He stays. He becomes Miguel. He starts again. And the line he made famous becomes the Najdorf: the weapon of Fischer and Kasparov.
phrases.say: He stays. He becomes Miguel. He starts again. And the line he made famous... becomes the Nigh-dorf. The weapon of Fischer and Kasparov.

phrases.text: Today it's one of the most popular openings in chess.
phrases.say: Today, it's one of the most popular openings in chess.

phrases.text: How many boards could you play blindfolded? Comment a number.
phrases.say: How many boards could you play blindfolded? Comment a number.
